trap.outlet: horizontal, towards the wall (+y), atmospheric at its end face

case.validNote: the run is valid up to validTo (water leaves over the rim after it)
case.wallClockNote: the first second ran about 4 times slower per step than the rest (the Mac was under load); the same run at normal speed would take about 25 minutes

wetRule: wall face wet when alpha.water > 0.5; model cell wet when more than half of its wall faces are wet; same rule at every sample (0.05 s); shares area-weighted with model cell areas

trap.regionNote: water (m3) in the bowl above the crest without the trapway (cell zone bowlAbove), in the bowl and well below the crest (the rest, including the first quarter of the half bend), and in the trapway from the dip section on, including the outlet bend and bore above the crest (cell zone trap)
trap.balanceNote: Qin = water from both jets, QoutWater/QoutAir = water and air through the outlet face (air negative when the outlet breathes in), Qrim = water out through the open top above the rim (m3/s); V* the same integrated from 0 over every solver step (m3); residual = Vdomain - Vdomain(0) - Vin + VoutWater + Vrim
trap.sectionNote: crest: section y = yCrest at the start of the horizontal bore, flux towards the outlet, depth = water depth in the round bore from the water share of the section; dip: section y = yDip under the back plate, flux on towards the rising leg, airShare = 1 - alphaMean, pRgh = area mean (Pa; p_rgh = p - rho g z with z = 0 at the crest), headLevel = pRgh / (998 g), the piezometric level of the water there (m above the crest); swirlWell: water-weighted mean tangential speed about the well centre in the plane z = -30 mm

seal.note: mean level over the last 0.5 s of the run, from a vertical line through the well (25 mm behind the axis) and one through the rising leg; seal = well level minus the dip (z = -55.0 mm)
